Problem Statement: \nHackerCon is conducting a hackathon for hackers to hack a self-driving automatic car that has been developed newly, to record the car's security breach index. The car is locked digitally with a matrix consisting of positive and negative integers. Only the owner of the car knows the matrix. The car's unlock code is unique. However, a group of hackers found a glitch in the car's software and reported that it can also be unlocked with the inverse of the matrix. This proved that the car did not have a unique unlock code. That group of hackers won the hackathon. Given a matrix, find out which was the matrix that the hackers used to unlock the car.\n\n
input_spec: Dimensions of the square matrix followed by the elements of a matrix
output_spec: Inverse of the matrix. If inverse does not exist, output “ Inverse does not exist”
